craft_notes: Sthāyin: kevalin economics. Rows: starve then fuel. Read aloud: lean then laden.

lines: Of the sage-knower that seed leans dissolving, so swells not its act;
but the rot-bound yawns forever, so that swollen seed
fruits nights and days of wandering-delight.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sa ca malo vijñānakevale vidyamāno dhvaṃsonmukha iti na svakāryaṃ karma āpyāyati
